_comment: Direct-question battery for the alt-model experiment's prompt-shape arm (brief: 2026-08-12). Bands: A = literature calibration (topics the published refusal studies use — R1dacted arXiv 2505.12625, Promptfoo CCP-sensitive set); B = cross-strait domain asked as direct questions; C = the SAME sensitive content wrapped in the production Tier-1 analytical scaffold (the bridge between regimes — Band C items carry article_id instead of text: the prompt is generated at run time via _tier1_prompt from an article BOTH models already analysed without refusing, and its sha256 is recorded per call); D = neutral controls. Bands A/B/D are matched EN/ZH pairs sent bare (no system prompt, fresh request per call). Band C is lang='mixed' by corpus constraint: the swept corpus is 100% Chinese-language and the Tier-1 scaffold is English-instructions-wrapping-original-language-content, so a 'pure EN' or 'pure ZH' Band C cell would require invented wording, which the brief forbids. ZH items use simplified or traditional per the register the literature tests (simplified — the models' pretraining-dominant script); B-06 quotes 九二共識 in traditional inside guillemets as Taiwanese sources write it. No jailbreaks, no adversarial prefixes — default behaviour only.
